reviews.text: Signed up my unruly pup for an online consultation with avid canine and said yes to the online puppy program. I did not regret the time and money spent at all. I was very happy with the service and attention that was given. My puppy learned the basics and obedience that I am now able to apply to both home and urban settings.  After the online puppy course my little puppy's manners greatly improved. I would highly recommend giving this course a go for you and your puppy.

I’ve tried several other trainers before for behavior training and they all focused on obedience which helped but didn't solve the problem. My dog, Jaxon was still reactive and lunging. I hired Marth and it was different because the first thing he focused on was teaching me everything I needed to know about Jaxon’s behavior and I how can make changes at home and everyday life and things improved dramatically and now I can walk Jaxon off leash and he ignores everyone around us and stays  focused on me. I would definitely recommend him for all of your training issues with your doggy’s. His prices are fair and a huge plus with the social classes he offers.
If you are looking for a dog trainer who will help you to actually understand your dog, why they do what they do and how to continue to work with them even after training is over - look no further!
